items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: Marshall and Ernie and Vernon and Irvin Ashby, they were all in the first

ctx.x: So would you be one — would you be on the dance floor or would you be one of those fellas that was like up —

Front row. Oh yeah. I was married at the time. My ex-wife, ooh, she used to get uptight. She’d get so mad because she loved to dance. I’d be either up front of else in the wings where I could watch the drummers. And Sonny Greer, now, was the most underrated drummer. He never got any publicity. But he held that band together. He was a burner, I mean for drums. In later years, when you look for something else, and if you listen to the records, you’ll find he’s another fella that fit that Duke band like a glove.…
Yeah you don’t raid Duke’s band, do you?
